name: @7ei/mission-control-mobile
description: 7Ei Mission Control — iPhone remote (Expo). Thin remote client to the hosted backend. Pinned to Expo SDK 54: the newest SDK the App Store build of Expo Go supports (see README § Expo Go).

install.//: SDK 54 pins react/react-dom to 19.1.0, but @clerk/clerk-js floors them at ~19.1.4. react-native@0.81.5 peers react at ^19.1.0, so 19.1.8 (newest 19.1.x) satisfies BOTH and dedupes Clerk onto one React copy. Excluded so `expo install --check` stops trying to pull them back to 19.1.0 and re-break Clerk. Re-evaluate on the next SDK bump.
